      Settings

      Space listen or pause · D drift, hold D to let the Earth turn · K keep · drag to turn the Earth yourself

      Each station is small or independent, and was checked to be on air when this list was made. Some will have faded since; Stray Hum drifts on when that happens. The Earth is lit as it is now: the sun where it stands, the night side in its own lights, and a recent day's clouds.

      Stations from Radio Browser · places from GeoNames · weather from Open-Meteo · relief from Mapzen terrain tiles · the Earth, its lights and clouds from NASA
